evidence.rule: positive growth requires at least N* settled playable rounds and a whole-round-bootstrap lower 95% bound above zero

multiple_comparisons: exploratory policies and splits are descriptive; do not select the best observed return
notes: Actual pre-match prices only; no retrospective fair-odds substitution.

ticket-construction-v3 records only; schema-1/2 rounds are excluded and are never pooled with v3.

protocol.evidence_rule: at least N* settled playable rounds and the whole-round bootstrap lower 95% bound on mean log growth above zero
protocol.inconclusive_rule: report inconclusive after 156 settled playable rounds without the evidence rule
protocol.n_star_rule: ceil(((z_0.95 + z_0.80) * sd(round log growth) / log(1.02))**2)
protocol.n_star_unavailable: report N* unavailable rather than invent a value
protocol.stop_adaptive_rule: upper 95% estimate of losing 50% within 52 rounds above 5%, or the owner's loss budget is breached
